result:
All four required pieces are in place, type-checking is clean, and the full test suite (617 tests) passes with no regressions.

Summary of changes:
- `src/schemas/project.ts`: added `cloneProjectSchema` / `CloneProjectInput`.
- `src/types/event.ts`: added `"project.cloned"` to `TaskflowEventMap`.
- `src/types/activity.ts`, `src/schemas/activity.ts`: added `"project.cloned"` to the audit action vocabulary; `src/components/domain/activity/activity-labels.ts` got the matching UI label (required since it's an exhaustive `Record<ActivityAction, string>`).
- `src/server/services/activity-service.ts`: records the `project.cloned` audit row (subject `project`, new project's id, metadata `{ sourceProjectId, issuesCopied }`).
- `src/server/services/project-service.ts`: added `cloneProject`, gated like a creation (read-source + create-project permissions, live-source check, project quota, then a single all-or-nothing issue-quota check for the whole batch before anything is written), builds the new project from the source's description/visibility/color/lead with the caller's name/slug/key, and emits exactly one `project.cloned` event.
- `src/server/repositories/issue-repository.ts`: added `cloneIssuesToProject`, which copies only live issues in source-number order, renumbering from 1, resetting status/assignee/parent/timestamps, and copying labels — leaving comments/attachments/the source untouched.
- `src/server/services/search-service.ts` and `usage-service.ts`: subscribe to `project.cloned` so the clone and its issues become searchable and the usage meters update immediately, since no per-item `project.created`/`issue.created` events fire for a clone (per ADR 0012 §6).
